n: const APP_VERSION="v22";(()=>{const run=()=>{const root=document.querySelector("#app")||document.body;const hs=[...root.querySelectorAll("h1,h2,h3,h4,[role=heading]")].filter(e=>e.offsetParent!==null);if(!hs.some(e=>/laporan\s+penjualan/i.test(e.textContent||""))||hs.some(e=>/laporan\s+laba\s+rugi/i.test(e.textContent||"")))return;for(const e of [...root.querySelectorAll("*")]){if(e.offsetParent===null||e.children.length>2)continue;const t=(e.innerText||e.textContent||"").trim().replace(/\s+/g," " );if(!/^(total\s*)?omset(\s*[:：].*)?$|^pendapatan(\s+per\s+produk)?$/i.test(t))continue;let p=e;for(let i=0;i<8&&p.parentElement;i++){if(p.matches("h1,h2,h3,h4,[role=heading]"))break;const q=p.parentElement;if(q.matches("section,article,.card,[class*=card],[class*=stat],[class*=metric],[class*=summary],[class*=report]")){p=q;break;}p=q;}if(p&&p!==root){p.style.setProperty("display","none","important");p.setAttribute("data-omset-hidden","v22");}}};new MutationObserver(run).observe(document.body,{childList:true,subtree:true,characterData:true});run();})();
